name: Fire Pledge
effect: User picks which stat to roll with. Move is Physical/Special in accordance with the choice. Hazard. Sets up Fire Pledge Hazard on the opponent's battlefield, which triggers every time a victim switches to another foe than the last one they targeted. When triggered, they deal 2 Dice of Damage. Add or subtract 1 dice for every weakness or resistance the victim has to Fire type, respectively. This effect lasts 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokemon chants to invoke the power of Fire. It's pledge is heard, then the flames consume everything around.
